worker_claim.summary: Generated fresh branch coverage and HTML, and inspected the annotated runtime.py source rather than relying only on aggregate percentages. Coverage debt is concentrated in _run_iteration_body, _validate_state_invariant, checkpoint/publication and lifecycle recovery, drop evidence, and reconciliation; the highest-value follow-up tests are scheduler divergence/zero-delta recovery, malformed persisted-state rejection, checkpoint publication replay, lifecycle races, and reconciliation success/conflict paths, while many malformed-input and Git/OS failure branches are legitimately defensive. No tracked product files were changed or staged; generated .venv, coverage.json, .coverage data, and htmlcov are ignored artifacts.
